mapper.select: SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , ROUND(t1.USD_WONBON_AEK * NVL(t1.JM_PER, 0) / 100, 2) AS usd_tuja , sonik.jm_sonik AS jm_sonik , sonik.pg_sonik AS pg_sonik , sonik.pg_premium AS pg_premium , sonik.put_premium AS put_premium , sonik.un_sonik AS un_sonik FROM SZT0IA_V t1 , SZM0IA ia , (SELECT ta.FUND_CD , SUM(NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK,0)) AS jm_sonik , SUM(ta.JM_PG_SONIK) AS pg_sonik , SUM(ta.PUT_PG_PREMIUM) AS pg_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.PUT_BF_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM,0)) AS put_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.JM_PG_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.PUT_PG_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM,0)) AS un_sonik FROM USPM_SONIK ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ta.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY ta.FUND_CD) sonik WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NVL(t1.DEL,'N') = 'N' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND sonik.fund_cd(+) = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_nm , t1.TRUSTEE AS trustee , t1.JM_CD AS sym0yz_jm_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , ya.JM_NM AS sym0ya_jm_nm , ya.JM_NM AS jm_nm , ya.HANGSA_GA AS sym0ya_hangsa_ga , ya.HANGSA_GA AS hangsa_ga , TO_CHAR(ya.LSY_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lsy_ymd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS jusu , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS aek , t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK AS tr_pyunga_aek , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , t1.IMP_JONGA AS imp_jonga , t1.IMP_VOLATILITY AS imp_volatility , t1.DELTA AS delta , t1.GAMMA AS gamma , t1.VEGA AS vega , t1.DELTA_RISK_VALUE AS delta_risk_value , t1.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE AS gamma_risk_value , t1.VEGA_RISK_VALUE AS vega_risk_value , NVL(t1.DELTA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(t1.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(t1.VEGA_RISK_VALUE, 0) AS risk_value FROM SYM0YZ t1 , SZM0IA ia , SYM0YA ya WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND ya.JASAN_GB = 'A' AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC, t1.TRUSTEE ASC, ya.LSY_YMD ASC, t1.JM_CD ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS jusu , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS aek , t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK AS tr_pyunga_aek , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK, 0) - t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK AS sonik , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , t1.IMP_JONGA AS imp_jonga , t1.IMP_VOLATILITY AS imp_volatility , t1.DELTA AS delta , t1.GAMMA AS gamma , t1.VEGA AS vega , t1.DELTA_RISK_VALUE AS delta_risk_value , t1.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE AS gamma_risk_value , t1.VEGA_RISK_VALUE AS vega_risk_value , NVL(t1.DELTA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(t1.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(t1.VEGA_RISK_VALUE, 0) AS risk_value , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'iw') AS week , lp.JONGA AS stock_jonga FROM SYM0YZ t1 , SYM0YA ya , SYT0LP lp WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US') AND t1.YMD <= TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND t1.TRUSTEE = #{trustee} AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND lp.CORP_GR(+) = t1.CORP_GR AND lp.YMD(+) = t1.YMD AND lp.JM_CD(+) = ya.CHANGE_JM_CD ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
